pages.text: $(bold)One awakening system, three recipe directions$(reset) — select Breakthrough at the Potion Table, then $(reset)click again to cycle modes$(reset) (Balance → Surge → Endure); the button shows the current mode.$(br2)$(bold)Shared tiers:$(reset) extra compatibility scales with purity in four steps = 2 / 4 / 6 / 8.$(br2)$(bold)They differ only in three respects:$(reset) base-stat amplification %, duration and crafting cost.$(br2)Selection summary:$(li)$(reset)Balance$(reset) = general-purpose$(li)$(reset)Surge$(reset) = short-window burst$(li)$(reset)Endure$(reset) = long-duration steady

pages.title: Balance (standard)
pages.text: $(bold)Role:$(reset) inherits the original breakthrough potion — complete, no weak spots, stable pacing.$(br2)$(bold)Numbers:$(reset) +5% base stats per point of extra compat$(li)Purity tiers → boost: +10% / +20% / +30% / +40%$(li)Duration: 30 minutes$(br2)$(bold)Recipe:$(reset) 5 Solid Matter + 30,000 life energy, 80 ticks.$(br2)$(bold)Best for:$(reset) overworld trips, mining and pre-boss all-round buffs — no extremes, but stable across a full dungeon run.

pages.title: Surge (burst)
pages.text: $(bold)Role:$(reset) a high-risk recipe that compresses the reward curve into a short window.$(br2)$(bold)Numbers:$(reset) +10% base stats per point of extra compat$(li)Purity tiers → boost: +20% / +40% / +60% / +80%$(li)Duration: 15 minutes (halved)$(br2)$(bold)Recipe:$(reset) 7 Solid Matter + 50,000 life energy, 100 ticks.$(br2)$(bold)Best for:$(reset) focused fights — use one before the Wither, dragon fight or PvP to push source organs past their usual ceiling; the cost is high and the window short.

pages.title: Endure (long haul)
pages.text: $(bold)Role:$(reset) a low-amplitude, long-lasting steady-state recipe.$(br2)$(bold)Numbers:$(reset) +3% base stats per point of extra compat$(li)Purity tiers → boost: +6% / +12% / +18% / +24%$(li)Duration: 60 minutes (doubled)$(br2)$(bold)Recipe:$(reset) 4 Solid Matter + 25,000 life energy, 120 ticks.$(br2)$(bold)Best for:$(reset) long AFK zones (mob farms, ranches, auto lines) — trades intensity for uptime, the lowest cost-per-minute of the three.
Shared mechanics (prerequisites / one-source cap / negative-trait suspension) are in Genotype Potions Guide; applicable ecosystem builds — see Ecosystem Synergy.
